_about: The guide's map of this page. ONE file read by both sides: api/chat.js builds the model's prompt and tools from it, and the browser uses it to jump to sections. To teach the guide a new section or demo, add an entry here (and the matching id in index.html). Run: node scripts/check-map.cjs

company.what: Squeez connects loyalty programs with sought-after experiences, so members get more meaningful ways to use their points and experience partners get new revenue.
company.live: Golf is live. Dining is coming soon.
company.tagline: Where loyalty, access and experiences come together.

audiences.label: Loyalty programs and brands
audiences.says: Brands bring more relevance and value to their members. Squeez connects loyalty points to bookable experiences.

audiences.label: Experience partners
audiences.says: Operators unlock new reach and revenue.

audiences.label: Strategic partners and investors
audiences.says: Coming soon. If this is you, the team would like to hear from you.

sections.label: the top
sections.summary: The opening. A sample redemption card shows a member using points for a weekend tee time.
sections.demo: The member moment: tapping Use my points confirms the booking with the words You're in.

actions.when: the visitor wants to see how a member gets in
they want to see it again

ask: How does a member get in?

sections.label: What we are
sections.summary: A four-step story: members want access to experiences; Squeez helps loyalty brands unlock it; Squeez connects loyalty points to bookable experiences; the moment, You're in.
sections.demo: Scrolling steps the story forward one beat at a time.

sections.label: Try it
sections.summary: An interactive control panel for a partner's own rules. Three sliders: the floor (below it a guest offer goes to the waitlist), the auto-approve line (at or above it the offer is approved automatically), and a sample guest offer. Between the two, the offer waits for the partner to decide.
sections.demo: Set the sliders and read the verdict. Offers below the floor are waitlisted; at or above the auto-approve line they are approved; in between they wait in the partner's queue. The auto-approve line is never shown to guests.

actions.when: the visitor gives numbers, or wants to try a scenario. Amounts are dollars per player, 0 to 40, floor never above auto-approve

sections.label: Who it’s for
sections.summary: Three tabs, one per audience: loyalty programs and brands; experience partners; strategic partners and investors (coming soon).
sections.demo: Opening a tab shows that audience's message and illustration.

actions.when: the visitor says which kind of organization they are, or asks about one audience

sections.label: Where it’s live
sections.summary: Two panels. Golf is live: the weekend tee time, secured with points. Dining is coming soon: the tables that look fully booked online. More to follow.
sections.demo: Hovering or focusing a panel expands it.

sections.label: What we believe
sections.summary: Three beliefs: loyalty should feel like being known; belonging should open doors; every point earned should become a moment worth telling.

sections.label: Partner with Squeez
sections.summary: The partnership call to action, linking to the contact page.
